basics.name: Alberto Morato
basics.label: Researcher
basics.summary: My research is centered on real-time communication networks, with a particular focus on hybrid Wired-Wireless-5G Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) systems. I specialize in the application of these networks in time-critical distributed measurement systems and the development of measurement techniques to assess their performance.

work.name: Department of Information Engineering, University of Padova
work.summary: Project: Real-time communication for embedded control systems in the industrial automation context. Research focused on the study and development of real-time communication architectures and protocols for embedded control systems, aimed at optimizing and ensuring the reliability of networks applied to industrial automation.

work.name: CNR-IEIIT, National Research Council of Italy
work.summary: Project iNEST - Interconnected Nord-Est Innovation Ecosystem, Spoke 5 (PNRR). Research on real-time communication networks, with emphasis on hybrid Wired-Wireless-5G Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) systems, distributed measurement systems, and performance measurement techniques.

work.name: CNR-IEIIT, National Research Council of Italy
work.summary: Project BAIS: Deterministic wireless networks for functional safety applications in Industrial IoT. Research on TSN over WiFi for functional safety, ultra-low-power wireless sensors for long-term industrial monitoring, and machine learning techniques for distributed communication and measurement systems.

work.name: CNR-IEIIT, National Research Council of Italy
work.summary: Project Bioingsec: Distributed functional safety systems based on wireless networks. Research on TSN over WiFi, ultra-low-power wireless sensors, and machine learning for distributed systems.

work.name: CMZ Sistemi Elettronici Srl
work.summary: Industrial IoT and Safety-Critical Real-Time Communication Networks. Proof-of-concept implementation of Fail Safe over EtherCAT (FSoE) on IEEE 802.11 WLAN, OPC UA evaluation for distributed IoT measurement, Profinet interface design for electric drives, embedded software for STM32 and TI real-time processors.

work.name: University of Padova / CMZ Sistemi Elettronici Srl
work.summary: Development of an electric drive with functional safety via fieldbus (FSoE) with SIL3/PLe characteristics according to IEC 61508 and IEC 61800. Activities included functional safety requirements analysis, FMEDA analysis, HW/SW architecture simulation via Simulink, and software quality.
